response.query: How will we map stakeholder incentives and potential resistance among market actors and local government, and what concrete safeguards protect the poorest households and women (intra-household measures, grievance channels)?
response.answer: Stakeholder incentives are aligned with environmental justice, while resistance is managed through grievance channels. Safeguards include intra-household measures and dedicated grievance mechanisms to protect the poorest households and women.

results.title: FY 2022-2026 Strategic Plan
results.content: Building on work already begun under President Biden’s Executive Orders3, and in alignment with the Administration’s whole-of-government approach, EPA is charting a course in this Strategic Plan where tackling climate change and advancing environmental justice and civil rights are integral to all the Agency does in carrying out the mission. EPA’s oversight role is critical to supporting effective implementation of federally delegated environmental programs by Tribes, states, and local entities, ensuring protection of civil rights, and protecting communities that have historically been underserved and overburdened. EPA will ensure that environmental education tools, trainings, curricula, resources, and grants align with strategic priorities to address climate change, advance environmental justice, support fenceline communities, promote science, and protect public health. 128  The following three learning priority areas were initiated in December 2019: Drinking Water Systems Out of Compliance; Workforce; and Grant Commitments Met. The fourth learning priority area, Expanding EPA’s Toolkit of Air Benefits Assessment Methodologies and Practices, was added to the Agency Learning Agenda in April 2021 after the capacity assessment survey was underway.
